name: triethylamine
functional_groups: N lone pair -> aminium radical cation
notes: irreversible; Ep/2-type value from Roth/Romero/Nicewicz table; common sacrificial reductive quencher

name: N,N-diisopropylethylamine
functional_groups: N lone pair -> aminium radical cation

name: N,N-dimethylaniline
functional_groups: N lone pair -> aminium radical cation
notes: radical cation dimerizes (benzidine formation); irreversible CV

name: N-phenylpyrrolidine
notes: approximate; value similar to N,N-dimethylaniline; verify against primary CV

name: 2-phenyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline
functional_groups: benzylic alpha-amino C1-H -> alpha-amino radical / iminium ion
notes: approximate literature value for aza-Henry / CDC substrate; verify

name: N,N,N',N'-tetramethylethylenediamine
functional_groups: N lone pair -> aminium radical cation

name: 1,4-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane
functional_groups: N lone pair -> DABCO radical cation (HAT catalyst / reductive quencher)
notes: quasi-reversible because Bredt-type bicyclic radical cation cannot easily deprotonate; stabilized by N-N 3e interaction

name: quinuclidine
functional_groups: N lone pair -> quinuclidinium radical cation (HAT abstractor of hydridic C-H)
notes: irreversible; value cited in Jeffrey/Terrett/MacMillan HAT paper

name: 3-acetoxyquinuclidine
functional_groups: N lone pair -> quinuclidinium radical cation (HAT catalyst)
notes: value from MacMillan HAT literature (Le/MacMillan Nature 2017); verify

name: triphenylamine
functional_groups: N lone pair -> triarylaminium radical cation
notes: reversible at fast scan, radical cation dimerizes slowly

name: tris(4-bromophenyl)amine
functional_groups: N lone pair -> stable aminium radical cation (magic blue precursor)
notes: reversible; radical cation is isolable ('magic blue')

name: N-methylmorpholine
functional_groups: N lone pair -> aminium radical cation
notes: approximate; morpholines oxidize less easily than trialkylamines (inductive effect of O)

name: morpholine
notes: rough estimate for secondary amine; secondary amines oxidize ~0.2-0.4 V more positive than tertiary

name: triethanolamine
functional_groups: N lone pair -> aminium radical cation
notes: approximate; widely used in water/MeCN for H2 evolution and CO2 reduction

name: N-phenylglycine
functional_groups: N lone pair oxidation then decarboxylation -> alpha-amino (anilinomethyl) radical

name: Hantzsch ester
functional_groups: C4-H (hydride / H-atom donor) -> pyridinium after 2e-/H+ loss
notes: irreversible; ~+0.9-1.0 V vs SCE reported (Fukuzumi); also photoexcited directly under violet light in some reactions

name: 1,3-dimethyl-2-phenyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-benzo[d]imidazole
functional_groups: C2-H -> benzimidazolyl radical (BI*) then benzimidazolium (BI+), strong 2e-/H+ donor
notes: irreversible; widely cited +0.33 V vs SCE (Hasegawa/Ishitani); BI radical E(BI+/BI*) ~ -2.06 V vs SCE

name: sodium ascorbate
notes: formal E°'(Asc•-,H+/AscH-) = +0.28 V vs NHE at pH 7, converted with E(SCE)=E(NHE)-0.241; strongly pH dependent

name: cesium tert-butyl oxalate
functional_groups: O-C(=O)CO2- -> double decarboxylation (2 CO2) -> tertiary/secondary alkyl radical (deoxygenative)
notes: Overman/MacMillan alkyl oxalates (Nawrat et al. JACS 2015); ~+1.28 V vs SCE reported for tert-alkyl Cs oxalate; SMILES given for tert-butyl example

name: oxalate
functional_groups: C-C cleavage after oxidation -> CO2 + CO2•- (strong reductant)
notes: approximate anodic peak for Bu4N oxalate; mechanism used in ECL (Ru(bpy)3/oxalate); E(CO2/CO2•-) ~ -2.2 V vs SCE

name: formate
functional_groups: C-H (HAT or SET/PCET) -> CO2•- radical anion (E(CO2/CO2•-) ~ -2.2 V vs SCE)
notes: poorly defined anodic wave; formate usually activated by HAT (thiol) rather than direct SET; treat value as rough

name: thiophenol
functional_groups: S-H -> thiyl radical (PhS•) after oxidation/deprotonation; HAT catalyst

name: thiophenolate
notes: approximate; thiolates are strong donors (EDA complexes with aryl halides)

name: thioanisole
functional_groups: S lone pair -> sulfide radical cation (-> sulfoxide, or alpha-thio C-H -> alpha-thio radical)

name: diphenyl disulfide
functional_groups: S-S -> radical cation; or reductive S-S cleavage -> PhS• + PhS-
notes: both values approximate; E_red is irreversible (dissociative)

name: cesium Boc-prolinate
functional_groups: CO2- -> carboxyl radical -> CO2 loss -> alpha-amino (alpha-carbamoyl) radical
notes: irreversible; value reported by Zuo/MacMillan (decarboxylative arylation)

name: tetrabutylammonium phenylacetate
notes: approximate; arylacetates oxidize ~+1.1-1.3 V vs SCE

name: cesium phenylacetate
notes: assumed equal to Bu4N salt; Cs salts poorly soluble in MeCN

name: tetrabutylammonium cyclohexanecarboxylate
notes: approximate; aliphatic carboxylates ~+1.2-1.3 V vs SCE

name: cesium 2-methoxyacetate (alpha-oxy carboxylate)
notes: approximate; alpha-oxy acids used by MacMillan for decarboxylative arylation/vinylation

name: potassium benzyltrifluoroborate
notes: irreversible; value measured by Akita and used by Tellis/Primer/Molander

name: potassium cyclohexyltrifluoroborate
notes: approximate; secondary alkyl BF3K ~+1.5 V vs SCE (Akita); hard to oxidize with Ir PCs

name: potassium (alkoxymethyl)trifluoroborate
notes: approximate; alpha-heteroatom BF3K oxidize more easily than unactivated secondary

name: potassium phenyltrifluoroborate
notes: approximate/uncertain; aryl BF3K rarely oxidized by common PCs

name: ammonium cyclohexyl bis(catecholato)silicate
notes: Fensterbank/Ollivier and Molander silicates; ~+0.69 V vs SCE; oxidizable by 4CzIPN/Ir

name: ammonium benzyl bis(catecholato)silicate
notes: approximate; Molander review gives silicate range +0.40 to +0.75 V vs SCE

name: ammonium primary-alkyl bis(catecholato)silicate
notes: approximate; primary alkyl silicates enable unstabilized primary radicals

name: 4-benzyl Hantzsch ester (4-alkyl-1,4-dihydropyridine)
functional_groups: C4-C(alkyl) -> alkyl radical + pyridine (aromatization driven fragmentation)
notes: approximate; 4-alkyl DHPs ~+1.0-1.2 V vs SCE; can also be directly photoexcited (lambda ~ 390 nm)

name: potassium O-ethyl xanthate
notes: rough estimate; xanthate anions are good donors in EDA complexes

name: sodium trifluoromethanesulfinate
functional_groups: S-O- -> CF3SO2• -> SO2 loss -> CF3• radical

name: sodium p-toluenesulfinate
notes: approximate; aryl sulfinates ~+0.4-0.5 V vs SCE

name: zinc difluoromethanesulfinate
notes: rough estimate, assumed similar to Langlois; verify

name: 1-(cyclohex-1-en-1-yl)pyrrolidine
functional_groups: enamine C=C/N -> enamine radical cation (3-pi-electron SOMO)
notes: approximate; enamine oxidation underlies SOMO catalysis

name: 1-(trimethylsiloxy)cyclohexene
functional_groups: enol silyl ether C=C -> radical cation -> Si loss -> alpha-carbonyl radical

name: 1-phenyl-1-(trimethylsiloxy)ethylene
functional_groups: enol silyl ether C=C -> radical cation -> alpha-carbonyl (phenacyl) radical

name: anisole
functional_groups: arene pi -> arene radical cation (nucleophile addition / C-H amination)

name: mesitylene
functional_groups: arene radical cation -> benzylic C-H deprotonation -> benzyl radical

name: toluene
functional_groups: arene radical cation -> benzylic C-H -> benzyl radical

name: naphthalene
notes: E_red in DMF ~ -2.5 to -2.6 V vs SCE

name: indole
functional_groups: indole pi -> radical cation (C3 nucleophilic / N-H deprotonation -> indolyl radical)

name: trans-anethole
functional_groups: C=C -> alkene radical cation (anti-Markovnikov nucleophile addition)

name: 1,1-diphenylethylene
notes: approximate; DPE also used as radical acceptor

name: tetrabutylammonium bromide
notes: approximate first anodic wave (Br- -> Br3-) in MeCN

name: tetrabutylammonium chloride
functional_groups: Cl- -> Cl• (strong HAT agent for C(sp3)-H)
notes: approximate; aqueous E°(Cl•/Cl-) = +2.43 V vs NHE

name: phenol
notes: approximate, irreversible; strongly coupled to proton transfer

name: sodium phenolate
notes: approximate; phenolates are also photoexcited directly in some reactions

name: allyltrimethylsilane
functional_groups: C-Si (beta-silyl stabilized radical cation) -> allyl radical

name: benzyltrimethylsilane
functional_groups: C-Si -> benzyl radical after desilylation of radical cation

name: N-(trimethylsilylmethyl)-N,N-dialkylamine (alpha-silylamine)
functional_groups: N radical cation -> C-Si cleavage -> alpha-amino radical
notes: approximate; alpha-silylamines oxidize slightly easier than parent amines
